code:
import os, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

three = json.load(open("ph_pocket_three_references.json"))
cons_tab = pd.read_csv("TABLE_ortholog_conservation_summary.csv")
be = json.load(open("bar_electrostatics_final.json"))
eq = json.load(open("csite_equivalence_ASAP1_ACAP3.json"))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14.5, 10))

# Panel A: basic fraction of the 5 A ligand shell, reference vs ACAP3
ax = axes[0, 0]
names = ["ASAP1_5C79", "PLCD1_1MAI", "GRP1_1FGY"]
pretty = ["ASAP1 PH\n5C79, PI(4,5)P2", "PLCdelta1 PH\n1MAI, Ins(1,4,5)P3", "GRP1 PH\n1FGY, Ins(1,3,4,5)P4"]
x = np.arange(3); w = 0.36
rb = [three[n]["ref_basic"]/three[n]["ref_n"] for n in names]
ab = [three[n]["a3_basic"]/three[n]["a3_n"] for n in names]
ax.bar(x-w/2, rb, w, color="#2c5f8a", label="reference PH domain")
ax.bar(x+w/2, ab, w, color="#c4622d", label="ACAP3 PH, mapped")
for i, n in enumerate(names):
    ax.text(x[i]-w/2, rb[i]+0.012, "%d/%d" % (three[n]["ref_basic"], three[n]["ref_n"]),
            ha="center", fontsize=9)
    ax.text(x[i]+w/2, ab[i]+0.012, "%d/%d" % (three[n]["a3_basic"], three[n]["a3_n"]),
            ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(pretty, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("fraction of 5 A ligand shell that is Lys, Arg or His")
ax.set_ylim(0, 0.72)
ax.set_title("A  ACAP3 presents a basic but less charged pocket\nat the inositol phosphate site of three references", fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=9, frameon=False)

# Panel B: ACAP3 residues recovered per superposition
ax = axes[0, 1]
res_sets = {n: [r for d, r in three[n]["acap3_shell"]] for n in names}
allres = sorted(set().union(*res_sets.values()), key=lambda r: int(r[1:]))
M = np.full((3, len(allres)), np.nan)
for i, n in enumerate(names):
    d = {r: dd for dd, r in three[n]["acap3_shell"]}
    for j, r in enumerate(allres):
        if r in d: M[i, j] = d[r]
im = ax.imshow(M, cmap="viridis_r", vmin=1, vmax=5, aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(allres)))
ax.set_xticklabels(allres, rotation=90, fontsize=9)
for j, r in enumerate(allres):
    if r[0] in "KR":
        ax.get_xticklabels()[j].set_color("#1a4f8a"); ax.get_xticklabels()[j].set_fontweight("bold")
ax.set_yticks(range(3)); ax.set_yticklabels(["vs ASAP1", "vs PLCdelta1", "vs GRP1"], fontsize=9)
for i in range(3):
    for j in range(len(allres)):
        if not np.isnan(M[i, j]):
            ax.text(j, i, "%.1f" % M[i, j], ha="center", va="center", fontsize=7, color="white")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, label="distance to ligand (A)", fraction=0.04)
ax.set_title("B  The same ACAP3 residues are recovered by all three\nsuperpositions (basic residues in blue bold)", fontsize=10.5, loc="left")

# Panel C: ortholog conservation
ax = axes[1, 0]
ct = cons_tab.sort_values("pct_identical", ascending=True)
cols = ["#1a4f8a" if r in "KRH" else "#999999" for r in ct["human_residue"]]
ax.barh(ct["position"], ct["pct_identical"], color=cols)
for i, (p, v, n) in enumerate(zip(ct["position"], ct["pct_identical"], ct["n_orthologs_scored"])):
    ax.text(v+1, i, "%.1f%% (n=%d)" % (v, n), va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0, 125); ax.set_xlabel("percent identical to the human residue")
ax.set_title("C  Conservation of the mapped pocket positions across\n91 vertebrate ACAP3 orthologs (blue = basic in human)", fontsize=10.5, loc="left")

# Panel D: BAR concave-face electrostatics
ax = axes[1, 1]
labs = ["Amphiphysin BAR\n1URU (control)", "ACAP1 BAR dimer\n4NSW crystal", "ACAP3 BAR model\nAlphaFold on 4NSW"]
keys = ["amphiphysin", "ACAP1", "ACAP3"]
conc = [be[k]["concave"] for k in keys]; conv = [be[k]["convex"] for k in keys]
delta = [c-v for c, v in zip(conc, conv)]
x = np.arange(3)
ax.bar(x-0.22, conc, 0.2, color="#2c5f8a", label="concave face")
ax.bar(x,      conv, 0.2, color="#8aa8c4", label="convex face")
ax.bar(x+0.22, delta, 0.2, color="#c4622d", label="concave minus convex")
ax.axhline(0, color="black", lw=0.8)
for i, d in enumerate(delta):
    ax.text(x[i]+0.22, d+0.012 if d > 0 else d-0.03, "%+.3f" % d, ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("screened Coulomb potential (kcal/mol/e)")
ax.set_title("D  The ACAP1 BAR concave face is not electropositive;\nthe amphiphysin control is", fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, frameon=False)

fig.suptitle("ACAP3 (Q96P50): the PH domain retains a reduced basic phosphoinositide pocket, the BAR concave surface does not carry the membrane charge",
             fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.965])
plt.show()
